title: An event's hero height setting changes the event page

source.ref: Unwired-things scan 2026-11-18 (project thread: Verify every feature path end to end); owner: full approval to make it all right

detail:
The event editor saved a hero height (short, standard, tall) and nothing read it, so the member event page always drew the standard cover. The page now reads readEventHeroHeight and the cover takes a short or tall height from the members theme.
